question: Would MAE and VFA treat a recombinant protein identical to the native protein as a detectable product of the modified gene under Joint Circular 45/2015 Art 1(2)(a), and may a product containing one below 5% still claim non-GMO?
why_it_matters: Decides whether precision-fermented proteins above 5% inclusion carry a GMO label and whether low-dose users keep non-GMO claims (DMV-16; ch24.2; OQ-201)
cheapest_way_to_close: Joint written question to MAE (Department of Science and Technology; Nature Conservation and Biodiversity) and VFA

question: Do packaged chay foods on sale now declare protein as Circular 30/2026/TT-BYT requires, and how many makers are exempt small businesses?
why_it_matters: Tells whether the protein gap can be tracked from labels and how much of the chay market sits outside nutrition labelling (OQ-171; TPP-02)
cheapest_way_to_close: Label audit of 50 packaged chay SKUs in two cities, recording nutrition panels and maker size

question: Does any province or VFA laboratory test chay products for meat or animal DNA, and with what results?
why_it_matters: State inspections found so far check hygiene and origin only; testing capacity decides whether meat-free claims can be enforced (DMV-07; DMV-13)
cheapest_way_to_close: Written request to VFA and the National Institute for Food Control; provincial Department of Health inspection reports before Vu Lan
owner_org_to_ask: VFA; NIFC; provincial Departments of Health

question: What do Decree 37/2026/ND-CP chapter IV and Art 49(1) say exactly: article numbers for the name and quantitative-ingredient rules, and the tolerance for declared protein?
why_it_matters: The tolerance sets the design margin for a 10 g per 100 g high-protein claim; article numbers are needed for citation
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the official gazette (Công báo) text of Decree 37/2026
owner_org_to_ask: MOST (National Committee for Standards, Metrology and Quality)

question: Will the revised Food Safety Law or its decree add claim conditions, a chay definition or reserved names for meat and dairy words?
why_it_matters: A reserved-name clause would reverse the naming finding and make DMV-15 urgent; a claim clause could make TCVN 14429 binding
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the draft submitted to the National Assembly session from October 2026 and the decree drafts
owner_org_to_ask: MOH (Food Safety Department); National Assembly Committee on Science, Technology and Environment

question: Does VFA treat giàu đạm (rich in protein) as the same claim as cao đạm (high protein) under TCVN 14429:2025?
why_it_matters: Decides whether giàu đạm on a chay food must meet 10 g per 100 g or 5 g per 100 kcal
